title: A City Without Homes
text:
Many people in our city do not have a home. Some of them sleep on the street, and others stay in small shelters. Local groups say this problem grows every year. They want the government to build more affordable houses.

Some volunteers help homeless people. They bring hot food and warm clothes on cold nights. They also help people find jobs. Many volunteers say that a small amount of help can make a big change.

questions.text: What do some homeless people do at night?
What do volunteers bring on cold nights?
Why do local groups want the government to build more affordable houses?
options: Because many people cannot pay high prices for homes
Because the city has too many empty houses
Because they want to move to the countryside
Because they do not trust the government

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about the help that volunteers give?
options: It can have a useful effect on people's lives
It is not useful for anyone
It only helps the volunteers themselves
It is too expensive to continue

vocabulary.definition: places that protect people from bad weather or danger
not expensive, so most people can pay for it
people who help others without being paid

paragraph_translations: Şehrimizde birçok insanın evi yok. Bazıları sokakta uyuyor, diğerleri ise küçük barınaklarda kalıyor. Yerel gruplar bu sorunun her yıl arttığını söylüyor. Ayrıca hükümetin daha fazla uygun fiyatlı ev yapmasını istiyorlar.

Bazı gönüllüler evsiz insanlara yardım ediyor. Soğuk gecelerde onlara sıcak yemek ve sıcak giysiler getiriyorlar. Ayrıca insanların iş bulmasına da yardımcı oluyorlar. Birçok gönüllü, küçük bir yardımın büyük bir değişiklik yaratabileceğini söylüyor.
